culture_principles.name: Merchant and entrepreneurship focus
culture_principles.description: Shopify-style fit should connect work to making commerce easier for entrepreneurs and merchants.

culture_principles.name: Builder craft and fast shipping
culture_principles.description: Strong candidates show builder judgment, high craft, clear communication, and the ability to ship useful work under changing conditions.

culture_principles.name: Growth through challenge
culture_principles.description: The public careers signal rewards curiosity, learning orientation, and comfort with difficult problems rather than comfort-seeking.

hiring_signals.signal: Frames decisions around merchant or entrepreneur outcomes rather than internal activity.
Shows builder ownership: identifies the problem, ships a concrete solution, learns from feedback, and improves the system.
Communicates tradeoffs clearly and keeps identity lightweight when evidence changes.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic enthusiasm for ecommerce without a merchant-impact mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Shopify fit requires connecting work to merchant success and practical commerce outcomes.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Slow, process-heavy answer that does not show ownership, craft, or shipping discipline.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The public careers signal emphasizes builders, craft, clear communication, and fast shipping.

interview_patterns.pattern: Behavioral and product judgment questions should test merchant empathy, builder ownership, shipping discipline, and learning from ambiguity.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official Shopify hiring standard.
It uses official public sources only and does not include private interview reports or paid-member materials.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
